''See also: [[Denner Weeks Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Denner Weeks, also known as Denner, is a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]] characterized by his unkempt appearance, often wearing stained brown traveling clothes and sporting facial stubble. He is known to be a somewhat unpredictable figure who frequently visits [[the House]] for short periods before departing without notice. Despite his casual demeanor and tendency to rest when not actively tasked, he possesses significant combat capabilities; he is capable of traveling between Overlords in a very short timeframe and can engage enemies by banishing his [[Dragon's Fang]] to summon different weapons, such as a spear from an armory. He carries a large red-and-gold book titled [[Hariman]], which serves as his advisor. Denner has demonstrated unique abilities, including the use of a technique he calls the glass bell. While he is a powerful combatant, he has also expressed concern regarding the readiness of younger individuals for dangerous tasks and has experienced instances where his [[Dragon's Fang]] was removed or appeared to stop listening to him.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Denner is a rough-looking man who wears a brown cloak. He carries a huge red-and-gold book and a red-wrapped sword known as [[Dragon's Fang]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|An old friend of [[Kai]], Denner is a former master of [[Valin]] who has passed his test as one of the true children. He provides advice to [[Simon]] and is tasked with protecting the [[Asphodel Incarnation]] alongside Eli.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Denner is an old friend of [[Kai]] and previously served as the master to [[Valin]]. He provided advice to [[Simon]] regarding a trial and is tasked alongside Eli to protect the [[Asphodel Incarnation]]. Additionally, Denner attempted to persuade [[Benson]] to provide him with [[steel]] and has not been in contact with [[Indirial]] for several weeks.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]], Denner possesses the ability to summon a spear from the armory. He also carries a talking book named [[Hariman]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Valinhall Traveler}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Denner Weeks is a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]] who once served as the master of [[Valin]] and facilitated the release of people from [[Valinhall]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c2">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c12">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c17">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 17</ref> As one of [[Valin]]'s true children to pass his test, he is a figure in a brown cloak whom [[Kai]] intends to alert.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c12" /> Carrying a huge red-and-gold book and the [[Dragon's Fang]], he smiled at [[Simon]] and noted that [[Kai]] lacks the [[Nye essence]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c7">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c12" /> Tasked with protecting the [[Asphodel Incarnation]] alongside Eli, he also carries a red-wrapped sword.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c12" /> This [[Traveler]] behind the King once attempted to convince [[Benson]] to provide him with [[steel]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c14">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 14</ref> During his interactions with [[Simon]], Denner patted him on the back, responded to him, and eventually left him a note.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c17" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c19">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c25">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 25</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Stay in the House}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Denner is a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]] who remains in [[the House]] for only a day or two at a time, having never learned to stop jumping around despite [[Valin]]'s attempts to teach him.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c6">''City of Light'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c13">''City of Light'', chapter 13</ref> [[Eldest|The Eldest]] once considered Denner for the [[Nye essence]] rather than [[Simon]], yet he still takes every opportunity available to depart from [[the House]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c16">''City of Light'', chapter 16</ref> [[Indirial]] has not received word from him in several weeks.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c17">''City of Light'', chapter 17</ref> Having had his [[Dragon's Fang]] removed, Denner is capable of summoning a spear from the armory.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c21">''City of Light'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref>}}
